discovery.hypothesis: If Daniil Tarasov starts for Detroit and Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back, the home side may be worth a closer look. Puck drop is 7:40 PM EST on Nov 18. CBS/Rotowire reported Tarasov as the starter after his 31-save shutout and showed DET at -117, but that may be stale. Detroit's goal differential trails Boston's per ESPN, and the sources disagree on records and Tarasov's stats.
discovery.question: Is Tarasov confirmed in morning skate, is Boston really on a back-to-back and starting Michael DiPietro instead of Jeremy Swayman, and has DET -117 already priced this in?
